```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
```


```{r}
#creating data frame of just the nanostring data I need

#Reading in nanostring data file
nano.data <- readxl::read_xlsx("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/mitox/data/Burd_clinicdata/Burd_NanostringSummary_June2022.xlsx", sheet = 2) %>%
  drop_na(Sample)

#removing empty rows ADORA2A:YWHAZ , `BMI (kg/m2)`, Therapy TNFRSF18, VTCN1, NECTIN2, AHR, CCR4, RUNX3
sampledata <- nano.data %>%
  select(Sample, ADORA2A:YWHAZ)

#getting all names to the same format
sampledata$Sample <-gsub(" ", "-", sampledata$Sample)
```

```{r}
#Reading in patient data
adjing.data <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/mitox/Clinical info/Patient Data 7-1-22.xlsm")


#selecting sheet with progressed/treatment completed
Adj_Datasheet <- readWorkbook(adjing.data, sheet = "Adj Datasheet", startRow = 2)

alting_names <- rename(Adj_Datasheet, Coded.Sample = 52, Drugs = 21, Date.of.treatment = 22)

new_status <- subset(alting_names, Cohort != "Excluded")

#creating dataframes with only sample and progression
status <- new_status %>%
  select(`Coded.Sample.#`, `Reason.for.discontinuation`)

#adjusting names to match
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <- gsub( " *\\(.*?\\) *", "", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <- gsub( " *\\(.*?\\)*", "", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <-gsub("- ", "-", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <-gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
#removing samples that aren't in nanostring
status2 <- subset(status, (`Coded.Sample.#` %in% sampledata$Sample)) 

```
